column1: # The index examples/typst-numbering.qmd prints in a Typst render (M099).
# Derived BY HAND from that source, under the ORACLE RULE at the head of
# tests/run-tests.sh, and never copied from a render. The row shape is the one
# tests/typst-index-main.tsv states. A locator of several words is written
# with the single spaces pdftotext puts between its words: `1 / 5`.
# Physical pages, from the source's page breaks and `set page` rules, with the
# page counter on each and the pattern in force:
# The index holds ten one-line entries under ten letter groups, which fit on
# one page, so page 8 is the last page. The final value of the page counter is
# therefore 5: 2 on page 5, plus one for each of pages 6, 7 and 8. A pattern
# naming two counters prints it as `5`, or as `V` for `I`.
# So a locator prints `1 / 5` on pages 1 and 3, `2 / 5` on pages 2 and 4,
# `ii of V` on page 5, `- 3 -` on page 6, and the physical page `7` on page 7.
#   apple    pages 1 and 3 print one text: one locator, linked to page 1
#   birch    a range from page 1 to page 3, both ends `1 / 5`: that text alone;
#            the mark on page 2 lies inside the range and prints nothing
#   cedar    ordinary on page 1, principal on page 3, one text: one bold
#   dune     ranges 1-2 and 3-4, both `1 / 5–2 / 5`: one locator, linked to 1
#   elm      a range opened and closed on page 1 and a mark on page 3, one
#            text: one locator, linked to page 1
#   fern     a range from page 2 to page 3, closing on a lower number
#   gorse    one mark under `i of I`, page 5
#   holly    page 4 and page 5 share counter 2 under two patterns: two locators
#   juniper  one mark on page 7, which has no numbering
